text:
maria: Quick pre-launch sync — blog + benchmark publish scheduled for TOMORROW 10:00 PT. We need a final press/embargo checklist, confirmed quotes, and tracking links. @kevin @olivia please confirm by EOD today.

kevin: On it. I'll confirm embargo partners and ask legal re: the new benchmark language. Sending a 9:00 PT review invite.

olivia: I updated the press list with EMEA contacts and added the localized headline suggestions. Sharing in a sec.

press-bot: Reminder: embargo window starts in 24 hours. Automated checklist: press list, quote approvals, tracking links, asset pack.

maria: Great — two quick asks: (1) final CEO quote (one-liner) and (2) a short tweet-sized blurb we can give partners.

kevin: Proposed CEO quote: "Our Optimize toolkit makes production inference predictable and far more economical for real workloads." Approve?

olivia: Works for me. Recommend swapping "far more economical" -> "materially more economical" for press.

maria: "Materially" is good. kevin, update and mark as final.

tom: Question on tracking: are we using one canonical UTMs for the benchmark blog or separate UTMs per partner outlet? I can generate the links.

maria: Single canonical UTM for headline + source param for partners. tom pls create master spreadsheet with final URLs and shortlinks.

tom: Will do. I'll put a column for partner_source and one for partner_shortlink.

sarah: Quick check on assets — is the benchmark CSV and the benchmark methodology doc finalized? I still see a TODO in the methodology near latency measurement section.

maria: Good catch. Research flagged that earlier — @kevin can you confirm methodology doc is the latest? We need the doc frozen for publication by 18:00 PT today.

kevin: I'll get the doc reviewed now, fix the latency paragraph, and upload v1.2 to the asset bucket.

olivia: Also: draft partner outreach email for journalists — short preview + embargo reminder. I'll paste the draft below for quick edits:
```
Hi [Name],
We wanted to give you an early look at Redwood Inference's Optimize launch and the associated benchmark results. Embargo: 10:00 PT tomorrow. Please reply if you need additional data or an interview.
Best,
Olivia
```

maria: Nice. Add a line offering an on-the-record call with @ceo for top-tier outlets.

kevin: Added. Also attaching final quoted figures for the blog (tokens/sec and cost-per-token improvements). Will post asset links when uploaded.

press-bot: Asset upload detected: s3://redwood-assets/optimize/v1.2/benchmark-pack.zip (uploaded by kevin)

maria: Perfect. Final checklist for today: 1) CEO quote approved (kevin) 2) methodology doc frozen (kevin) 3) assets uploaded (kevin) 4) UTMs + shortlinks (tom) 5) partner email + press list confirmed (olivia) 6) embargo reminder scheduled (press-bot). Please reply here once your item is done.

kevin: Done on quote + doc + assets.

tom: Shortlinks + spreadsheet done, shared in the calendar invite.

olivia: Partner email ready and press list finalized.

sarah: Methodology spot-checked. All good from research.

maria: Thanks team. I'll post the final publishing checklist in this thread and schedule the publish at 10:00 PT tomorrow. If anyone spots an issue overnight ping me directly. :thumbsup:
